name: provia-process-discovery
title: Process discovery and pilot selection
titlePt: Descoberta de processos e escolha do piloto
description: Choose a suitable first Provia process from an organization’s repeated work and constraints.
inputs: Process inventory, recent cases, pain points, volumes, owners, constraints and baseline measures.
output: A ranked shortlist, an explained pilot choice, boundaries, owner, success measures and open questions.
steps: Identify the event that starts each process and the observable condition that ends it. Distinguish repeatable organizational work from one-off tasks.
Compare impact, frequency, handoff delay, evidence gaps, ownership and implementation effort. Do not invent volumes or monetary savings.
Choose a pilot with a named owner and enough real cases to learn from. Separate observed baseline values from estimates.
Define the smallest useful scope and a review after several completed incidents. Hand an agreed design brief to the workflow designer.
promptPt: Na nossa empresa em Luanda, compras, admissão de trabalhadores e pedidos de TI são tratados por correio electrónico. Ajude-nos a escolher um piloto.
promptEn: Compare our processes and explain which one fits a four-week pilot.
incomplete: When volume or ownership is missing, give a provisional comparison and the information needed to decide.
conflict: When the fastest process has no owner but another has clear ownership, explain the trade-off instead of ranking by speed alone.

name: provia-workflow-designer
title: Procedure-to-workflow designer
description: Turn supplied procedures, SOPs and checklists into a Provia workflow design.
inputs: Procedure, start/end conditions, roles, approval rules, required evidence and exceptions.
output: An action table, execution sequence, decision outcomes, assignments, due-date rationale and a source-to-design mapping.
steps: Extract explicit requirements with references to sections of the supplied procedure. Mark recommendations separately.
Choose Standard, Decision, Notification, Wait, HTTP Request, Sub-workflow or Form Fill by the required outcome. AI is an assignee on Standard actions.
Use sequential ordering for actual dependencies and parallel execution only for independent work. Model rework and rejection explicitly with supported decision outcomes.
Use a Form trigger for intake and Form Fill for an existing incident. Do not represent a human approval as an automatic threshold engine.
Use a reusable sub-workflow only when it has its own meaningful start, completion and owner. Identify mappings and cancellation behavior.
Return a reviewable design first. When the user requests YAML, use the workflow-package skill and its actual validator.
promptPt: Transforme o nosso procedimento de compras num workflow. A chefia aprova o pedido e as Finanças confirmam a disponibilidade orçamental.
promptEn: Turn this onboarding SOP into actions, approvals and exception paths.
incomplete: If the procedure lacks a rejection path, identify the gap and propose one as a recommendation.
conflict: If two procedure sections give different approvers, expose the conflict and keep it unresolved rather than silently choosing.

name: provia-information-model
title: Business information model
description: Design Provia entities, incident metadata, mappings and tags for a business process.
inputs: Business objects, sample records, reporting questions, forms and existing conventions.
output: An entity model, field dictionary, mappings, tag taxonomy and data-minimization rationale.
steps: Use entities for reusable records such as suppliers, assets or employees. Use incident metadata for facts about one execution.
Keep collection-only form answers on submissions unless routing, reporting or integration requires incident metadata.
Choose supported metadata types and stable ASCII snake_case field names. Localize labels and descriptions, never YAML keys or enums.
Specify field purpose, type, requirement, options, default, owner and sensitivity. Do not collect identity or financial details without a process need.
Separate controlled select values from flexible tags. Entity records/types and tags are setup dependencies, not definitions automatically created by workflow YAML.
promptPt: Como organizar fornecedores e pedidos de compra sem repetir os dados do fornecedor em cada pedido?
promptEn: Which fields belong to the supplier and which belong to a purchase request?
incomplete: If reporting needs are unknown, keep optional collection small and identify the unanswered reporting questions.
conflict: If a form collects personal information without a use, flag it and explain which fields can remain on the submission or be removed.

name: provia-form-designer
title: Intake and evidence forms
titlePt: Formulários de entrada e de recolha de evidências
description: Design intake forms and Form Fill responses with appropriate access and mappings.
inputs: Respondents, desired answers, process stage, access constraints, uploads and response policy.
output: A form specification with fields, validation, access, mappings, uploads, confirmation and testing steps.
steps: Decide whether submission creates an incident or supplies evidence to an existing one. Use intake Form versus Form Fill accordingly.
Define internal/external respondents and the intended access path. Do not promise anonymous access or an external link without checking the configured form behavior.
Map only compatible fields needed by the incident. A single Form Fill response can map values and complete the action; multiple responses are a review collection and cannot map competing values.
Specify file types/sizes and the reason each document is needed. Write a confirmation that states what happens next without promising an unconfigured deadline.
Deliver form specifications separately from YAML. Forms are not packaged in the portable contract; require creation/linking and preview in Provia.
promptPt: Precisamos de recolher três propostas de fornecedores durante um pedido de compra.
promptEn: Design a self-service IT request form with a clear confirmation.
incomplete: If the respondent access model is unknown, present the available design decision and mark access testing as pending.
conflict: If multiple quotations are requested but each should overwrite incident amount, explain the conflict and propose a review step.

name: provia-workflow-package
title: Workflow package builder
titlePt: Gerar e validar ficheiros de workflow
description: Generate, explain or repair portable Provia workflow YAML and run the bundled validator.
inputs: An agreed design or YAML export, source contract version, known destination references and setup constraints.
output: workflow.yaml, validation.json and a separate setup.md describing remaining configuration.
steps: Read ../../references/workflow-yaml.md and ../../contracts/workflow-v1/contract-lock.json before emitting YAML. Start from a relevant bundled example rather than inventing property names.
Emit provia.ao/v1 and Workflow. Preserve exact enum values, native booleans, integer offsets and stable local action IDs. Use only supported top-level sections.

Never invent organization UUIDs. If an intended assignee/reference is unknown, keep it in setup.md and explain any deliberate omission in the importable draft. Never silently replace the actual owner with the creator.

Keep credentials out of files. Use supported placeholders and secret references with named dependencies. Keep forms, tags, files, page templates, memory documents and unsupported assignment strategies in the handover.

Run node ../../scripts/validate-workflow.mjs <workflow.yaml> from this skill directory, or resolve that script from the installed plugin root. Node 20+ is required; no npm installation or network is needed.
Fix errors and run again. Return the exact validator output. If execution is unavailable, say validation was not run and provide the command. Do not simulate a successful validation report.
Explain errors, warnings and pending destination checks separately. Provia import preview/server dry run and a human publish review still follow. Do not call an export a full backup.
promptPt: Gere o YAML do pedido de compra aprovado e valide o ficheiro antes de o entregar.
promptEn: Repair this exported YAML without changing the intended approval process.
incomplete: If owner IDs are unavailable, deliver a draft with an explicit assignment handover instead of fabricated UUIDs.
conflict: If the user requests embedded form definitions or translated YAML keys, explain the contract boundary and preserve the form specification separately.

name: provia-workflow-review
title: Workflow design review
description: Review a Provia workflow for ownership, sequencing, evidence, exceptions and publication readiness.
inputs: Workflow design or export, intended business outcome, procedure and known dependencies.
output: A prioritized findings list with evidence, proposed corrections and representative test scenarios.
steps: Trace each required outcome to an action and its completion evidence. Check that decisions include rejection/rework where the procedure requires them.
Check predecessor dependencies, parallel actions, missing owners, unavailable groups, due bases and cancellation behavior.
Review data collection, form mappings and secret dependencies. Use workflow-package for executable YAML checks; do not replace those checks with visual inspection.
Distinguish a product contract error, a business-policy gap and an optional improvement. Do not claim organizational or legal compliance from a structurally valid file.
Return normal, rejected, incomplete and failed-integration scenarios with expected visible results. Leave destination validation and publication clearly pending.
promptPt: Reveja este workflow antes de publicarmos. Procure etapas sem responsável e caminhos de rejeição em falta.
promptEn: Can these parallel actions start before budget approval?
incomplete: If the SOP is absent, review structural issues and identify which policy questions cannot be adjudicated.
conflict: If the YAML validates but the process bypasses approval, report the business defect separately from file validity.

name: provia-organization-rollout
title: Organization setup and adoption
description: Plan Provia ownership, groups, training and adoption for a team or organization.
inputs: Teams, administrators, process owners, pilot results, existing permissions and rollout constraints.
output: A role/group proposal, training exercises, rollout milestones and measurable adoption reviews.
steps: Separate organization administration, group administration, process ownership and action responsibility. Explain proposed permissions without claiming to grant them.
Prefer durable team ownership when continuity matters. Explain available assignment approaches, but mark strategies absent from YAML as configuration outside the package.
Use a small pilot, gather evidence from completed incidents and expand after reviewing confusion, late work and missing evidence.
Create role-specific exercises: start an incident, complete an action, make a decision and review a report. Define who provides support.
Measure completed useful work and ownership coverage, not only account creation or logins. Respect plan/role availability of reports and AI.
promptPt: Vamos começar com Compras e depois alargar à equipa de Recursos Humanos. Prepare um plano de adopção.
promptEn: Design group ownership and training for a cross-department rollout.
incomplete: If no process owner is named, identify that dependency before treating the rollout as ready.
conflict: If everyone is proposed as administrator, explain the authority actually needed by each role.

name: provia-automation-designer
title: Automation and integrations
description: Specify Provia notifications, waits, triggers, HTTP calls and reusable sub-workflows.
inputs: Target event, system API contract, payload examples, timing, access restrictions and failure handling.
output: An integration specification with mappings, dependencies, retries, timeouts and exception paths.
steps: Choose manual, email, webhook or schedule for an event; choose Form for structured human intake. Choose Notification for informing people and Wait for elapsed time or a supported condition.
For HTTP calls use the actual external API documentation or user-supplied contract. Never invent endpoints. Use organization secret references and identify destination allowlist requirements.
Specify idempotency where the external API supports it, expected responses, response mappings and what happens after retries fail.
For schedules use a numeric five-field cron and an explicit timezone. Workdays skip weekends; they do not implement statutory holiday calendars.
Keep AI judgment separate from deterministic calls and human decisions. Provide setup instructions instead of implying that the plugin has connected systems.
promptPt: Quando o pedido for aprovado, precisamos de o enviar para o ERP. Temos esta documentação da API.
promptEn: Design a monthly review trigger in Africa/Luanda with a clear missed-run policy.
incomplete: If the external API is unknown, produce an integration requirements list, not a guessed endpoint.
conflict: If retries can create duplicate purchases, identify the duplicate risk and require a supported idempotency or reconciliation design.

name: provia-ai-action-designer
title: AI actions and profiles
description: Design reviewable AI-assigned Standard actions and narrowly scoped Provia agent profiles.
inputs: Task, supplied evidence, expected artifact, available fields, review policy and plan availability.
output: Profile instructions, required skills, output contract, review behavior and evaluation cases.
steps: Assign AI to a Standard action. Confirm the task has a reviewable result such as a summary, classification or proposed document.
Define objective, inputs, rules and output. Restrict readable/writable fields and skills to the work; avoid granting broad access for convenience.
Use human review for new or judgment-heavy tasks and keep final approvals with authorized people. State behavior for missing and contradictory evidence.
Distinguish profile instructions from approved workflow Agent Memory. Memory documents are not carried by YAML.
Test normal, incomplete and contradictory examples. Explain plan/settings prerequisites and never imply this external plugin installs profiles in Provia.
promptPt: Queremos que a IA resuma propostas, mas que a escolha do fornecedor continue a ser feita pela equipa.
promptEn: Write a profile for classifying IT requests with human review.
incomplete: If expected artifacts are not defined, propose a reviewable output and identify the missing acceptance criteria.
conflict: If the user asks AI to approve its own analysis, separate preparation from the authorized decision.

name: provia-operations-triage
title: Operational triage
description: Analyze supplied incident/action records for overdue, blocked, unassigned or stalled work.
inputs: Authorized record export, observation time, timezone, statuses, ownership and due dates.
output: An evidence-backed attention list with reasons, record references, suggested owners and next steps.
steps: State the export period and observation time. Treat snapshots as snapshots; do not claim to be monitoring live Provia.
Check missing/duplicate records and interpret states with the current product reference. Prioritize time-sensitive impact, overdue dependencies and unclear ownership.
Use action and incident references to substantiate each finding. Distinguish overdue, blocked and merely waiting.
Propose actions and handoffs without completing records or sending messages. Identify the authorized person who can act.
If history is insufficient to infer a cause, describe the symptom and the next record to inspect.
promptPt: Com base nesta exportação, quais são os pedidos que precisam de atenção hoje em Luanda?
promptEn: Explain which blocked actions are delaying these incidents.
incomplete: If due dates or the export time are missing, avoid claiming which work is overdue.
conflict: If two rows disagree about status, flag the conflict and avoid choosing the more convenient record.

name: provia-process-improvement
title: Process performance improvement
description: Analyze supplied Provia reports and exports to propose measurable process improvements.
inputs: Comparable reporting periods, workflow/version scope, raw records, metric definitions and business question.
output: Findings, reproducible calculations, limitations and a proposed change with a measurement plan.
steps: Check time coverage, timezone, duplicates, missing completion dates and comparable workflow versions before comparing periods.
Distinguish cycle time, active work and waiting. State formulas, denominators and exclusions. Do not infer individual performance from raw case duration.
Connect bottlenecks to underlying cases, decisions and comments. Present possible causes as hypotheses until supported.
Choose one change with a process owner, expected mechanism and follow-up measure. Identify confounders such as volume or complexity changes.
Provia report availability is role/plan dependent. Scheduled report delivery is not implemented in the pinned baseline; do not promise it.
promptPt: Este relatório mostra que as compras demoram mais. Identifique onde se perde tempo e como testar uma melhoria.
promptEn: Compare these two periods without mixing waiting time and active work.
incomplete: If the denominator or sample period is absent, request it or label the calculation as incomplete.
conflict: If workload rose alongside cycle time, discuss the confounder before attributing the change to an employee.

name: provia-controls-evidence
title: Controls and evidence review
description: Map supplied organizational requirements to Provia actions and execution evidence.
inputs: Applicable policy or verified legal sources, workflow design, incident records and evidence.
output: A requirement/action/evidence matrix, gaps, source references and follow-up ownership.
steps: Establish jurisdiction, effective dates and the exact requirement sources. Separate legislation, company policy and recommendations.
Map each requirement to the responsible action, decision, required data/document and evidence of execution.
Distinguish a designed control from proof it operated in a specific incident. Missing evidence does not by itself prove the activity never happened.
Quote or cite the relevant supplied provision. Verify current legal claims against authoritative sources; if verification is unavailable, record the limitation.
Return findings and remediation proposals. Do not certify compliance, invent legal retention periods or claim that an audit trail alone meets every requirement.
promptPt: Compare o nosso procedimento de compras com estes registos e indique as evidências em falta.
promptEn: Map this approved policy to workflow actions and the evidence from three incidents.
incomplete: If legal sources or dates are missing, limit the review to the supplied organizational policy.
conflict: If a template cites Brazilian legislation for Angola, identify the jurisdiction mismatch rather than adopting it.

name: provia-process-knowledge
title: Procedure and knowledge maintenance
description: Create or reconcile SOPs, action instructions, runbooks and proposed Agent Memory from supplied Provia designs.
inputs: Current workflow version, approved policies, existing guidance and incident lessons.
output: A sourced procedure or knowledge artifact with owner, scope, version, conflicts and review needs.
steps: Identify the source workflow version and distinguish published procedure from proposed changes.
Write each action instruction around inputs, task, completion evidence, owner and exceptions. Preserve real approval authority.
Reconcile conflicts between workflow and policy explicitly. Do not silently promote incident workarounds to organization-wide policy.
Keep stable approved guidance in proposed Agent Memory; keep temporary case facts in the incident. Memory proposals need administrator review.
Provide concise standalone artifacts with source references and an update owner. Pages and memory documents require separate setup after YAML import.
promptPt: Actualize as instruções deste procedimento com base no workflow aprovado e nestas lições do piloto.
promptEn: Turn this approved procedure into a concise runbook and a proposed memory glossary.
incomplete: If the current approved version is unknown, label the document as a draft.
conflict: If a case workaround contradicts policy, record it as an exception to review rather than rewriting the policy.

name: provia-workflow-change
title: Workflow change planning
description: Plan changes to a Provia workflow with attention to active incidents, data and dependencies.
inputs: Current and proposed designs, active-incident evidence, affected fields/integrations and change reason.
output: A semantic comparison, impact assessment, draft-version plan, test cases and recovery instructions.
steps: Compare intended behavior, owners, decisions, fields, forms and integrations. Explain business effects instead of only listing YAML line changes.
Identify active incidents that depend on changed fields. Runtime actions are instantiated, but some validation still consults workflow-level metadata.
Plan a new draft and publication. Trigger forms publish independently; Form Fill definitions are frozen with workflow publication.
There is no general one-click rollback control. Describe how to create a new draft that reapplies a previous design and separately address active cases.
Test the changed and unchanged paths, re-link excluded dependencies and communicate effective dates. Do not claim a YAML re-import preserves version lineage.
promptPt: Queremos alterar os campos obrigatórios deste workflow, mas ainda existem pedidos em curso.
promptEn: Plan a new version with an extra approval without losing evidence from open cases.
incomplete: If active incidents cannot be inspected, identify that impact check as pending.
conflict: If the user expects re-import to restore history, explain that it creates a new draft lineage and propose a versioned recovery plan.
